A and K are finite constants independent of the subsequent C_* increase

checks.derivation: Raise C_* P_* >= exp(40 A + 1)(1+A) to the tenth power and multiply by 110.
C_* >= 1 implies C_*^10 >= C_*^8; substitute R_ref=110(C_*P_*)^10 and multiply by exp(-8).
